name: Navda
tagline: 2D and 3D situational maps and digital flight strips for air traffic controllers.
problem: Control-tower systems are outdated, controllers are scarce and close calls are rising.
solution: Interactive 2D and 3D maps of nearby aircraft and a digitised flight-strip system, designed to ingest federal air-traffic data.
demo_moment: Team-described: select an airport and see live aircraft in 3D with their strips.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Supports existing controllers rather than replacing them.

lessons: 3D context for an expert user can win an AR/VR prize without a headset.
